newsitem.title: UK: Interest picks up for NWE diesel, prices hold stea.
newsitem.headline: Interest picks up for NWE diesel, prices hold stea.

text.p: NWE gas oil was broadly steady on Friday with a trickle of deals done to keep the market ticking over. Diesel was the grade of choice for most buyers.
April IPE gas oil closed 25 cents firmer at $162.25 a tonne after a quiet trading day.
Heating oil barge premiums were a touch easier, losing about 25 cents with trades concluded at April IPE -25 cents fob Antwerp and April IPE +50 cents fob Flushing.
Diesel barges were pegged around April IPE +$11 fob, but most of the interest appeared directed at cargoes.
"We have seen bits and pieces done into U.K. and France for handysize cargoes," said one trader.
A cargo of 0.05 was sold into Rostock at April IPE +$9.50 in conjunction with a DIN cargo cif Bremen at April IPE +$2.75.
Russian premiums were holding steady around April IPE +$1-1.50 with bids and offers on either side of this. A major bought at mean of the means +50 cents.
Demand from Asia continues although nearly all the large "arbitrage friendly" cargoes already have homes. Traders said they expected more large tankers fixing next week eastwards.
FOD was subdued with little interest limiting talk. Premiums were notionally assessed as steady around April IPE +3 cif NWE.
